summary.name: Wavefunction
summary.one_liner: Wavefunction is a free, MIT-licensed, open-source desktop coding agent for macOS that runs several tasks in parallel using local models, your own API keys, or a ChatGPT sign-in.
use_cases: run several coding tasks in parallel in one conversation
code with local models for privacy
use a ChatGPT Plus or Pro subscription for a coding agent
track token usage and API spend for coding agent
connect MCP servers and reuse AGENTS.md or SKILL.md files
let an agent operate a sandboxed desktop in Docker
summary.what_it_does: Wavefunction is a macOS desktop app for coding with an AI agent in a single chat-style interface. It can split work across subagents, runs each chat on its own git branch, and gives subagents that might touch the same files their own worktree before merging their changes. Users can send follow-up messages while tasks run and steer subagents mid-task, and can fork a chat or rewind code and conversation. Models can be chosen per chat from ChatGPT sign-in, API keys for Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter or Vercel AI Gateway, or local servers such as Ollama and LM Studio. The page also describes token and cost tracking, 70+ MCP connectors plus custom MCP servers, and support for AGENTS.md and SKILL.md files.
notable: Parallel subagents with per-chat branches and git worktrees for conflict-free work
Computer use in a local Docker container so the user's mouse, keyboard and screen are not taken over
Model choice per chat: local models, own API keys, or ChatGPT sign-in
Reads AGENTS.md and SKILL.md files and supports MCP connectors
caveats: Computer use requires Docker Desktop and a model that can read images
Model usage charges are paid to the chosen provider, not to Wavefunction
